details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url at 3040-3052; _resolve_origin_url at 3077-3083 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using per-process http.extraHeader authentication.
  WHY: Token-bearing URLs are exposed in process arguments, Git diagnostics, persisted remotes, and workflow logs, and tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py rejects this contract regression.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url at 578-581; memory_ensure_branch at 151 and 180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: _memory_git was deleted, memory branch operations use bare git commands against credential-free origins, and force-tick URLs embed tokens.
  WHY: With persist-credentials: false, authenticated operations fail while token-bearing URLs leak credentials; fail-open handling silently leaves ai-memory unavailable.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:is_sensitive_target_path at 155-167 (deleted); normalize_path at 240-247 (sensitivity check removed) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was removed from path normalization and resolved-path handling.
  WHY: Issue- or plan-derived paths such as .git/config, .env, .ssh/id_rsa, and .aws/credentials can be read into model prompts because repository-boundary checks do not block sensitive files inside the repository.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:line 668 (codex invocation) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase invokes Codex directly with --sandbox danger-full-access instead of using the model-provider broker and sanitized execution.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic input reaches a model with access to workspace files, network, GH_TOKEN, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, and other credentials.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:file now ends at line ~139; deleted model_provider_broker_start/stop/prepare_codex_writer/prepare_codex_readonly/exec_sanitized/exec_unprivileged/grant_read_path | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The shared model-provider broker lifecycle and execution functions were deleted while live workflows and scripts still call them.
  WHY: Model-facing phases abort with command not found before Codex starts, and the centralized credential-isolation boundary is removed.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:Usage at 4-7; option parsing at 30-66 (--process-group-file case deleted) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The --process-group-file option was removed while scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh still passes it when editor isolation is enabled.
  WHY: The stall guard exits with unknown option and return code 2 before the isolated editor launches, and the existing contract tests still require the option.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:Lines 229-460 (process-group metadata writing, isolated group membership verification, privileged signaling, survivor reaping) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Process-group metadata, isolated identity tracking, privileged signaling, and survivor verification were deleted.
  WHY: Isolated editor descendants can survive parent termination and cleanup cannot locate or prove that the process group is dead.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:git_with_github_auth at 493-506 (deleted); review_blocked_decision_digest through review_blocked_prepare_successor_issue at 732-947 (deleted) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: git_with_github_auth and the review_blocked_* helper family were deleted while review_rb_judge.sh, orchestrate_poll_process.sh, and tests still invoke them.
  WHY: Judge-fix pushes and terminal approval flows fail with command not found or unauthenticated git operations, stalling review-blocked processing.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:REST transform at 766-772; GraphQL transform at 833-839 and 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized comments[] payloads no longer include id, author_id, author_type, or author_association.
  WHY: Producer authentication, approver authorization, and comment-id-based thread handling cannot be evaluated.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:--provider-base-url option parsing at 82-112 (removed); config generation at 258-264 (hard-coded https://openrouter.ai/api/v1) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: --provider-base-url was removed while callers still pass the loopback broker URL, and configuration generation hard-codes the public OpenRouter URL.
  WHY: Callers exit with unknown argument before writing configuration, while callers omitting the option bypass the loopback broker.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:98-237 (staged_support_ledger block); references to IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR at 443-582 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Staged-support restore/rebase logic depends on STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER, STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR, and IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR, but .github/workflows/implement.yml does not export them.
  WHY: The guard is inactive, allowing self-repository implement runs to overwrite branch-owned helper edits with staged support-ref copies.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:Import of MAX_TARGET_PATHS at line 30; import of is_sensitive_target_path at line 37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports MAX_TARGET_PATHS and is_sensitive_target_path after both symbols were deleted from scripts.targeted_file_context.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises ImportError and CI fails before the targeted-context tests run.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config at line 100 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config writes ${HOME}/.codex/config.toml instead of ${CODEX_HOME:-${HOME:-/root}/.codex}/config.toml.
  WHY: When CODEX_HOME is set, Codex reads a different configuration file and silently ignores the reasoning-effort override.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 62-66 (pre_assembled_static.txt handling) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The HEAD-existence check was replaced with an index check, restore lost --staged, and the git rm --cached branch was removed.
  WHY: Staged deletions or modifications can remain in the index, leaving tracked state inconsistent and defeating artifact cleanup.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:python3-availability branch (lines 127-136) and run_without_guard (lines 13-24) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The missing-python fail-closed path and state=unguarded status write were removed.
  WHY: An isolated editor can run without watchdog supervision, while downstream cleanup cannot detect that the run was unguarded.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context rewrite (lines 536-716) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file, binary, and overflow markers do not advance used_bytes, and MAX_TARGET_PATHS was removed.
  WHY: Large untrusted path lists can produce output exceeding TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES and the existing strict-bounds test fails.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:204 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The reported git merge-file argument-order defect is not present.
  WHY: git merge-file receives current=editor, base=staged_support_base, and other=staged_support_head, which matches the intended semantics; this reviewer confirmed the code is correct.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line: the re-audit checks sibling code paths (other venues, adapters, handlers, workers) for the same defect and re-opens the loop if any remain."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/validation-improvements-intake.yml and scripts/review_rb_judge.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: .github/workflows/validation-improvements-intake.yml still uses script_ref="stable" with a main fallback and mutable helper sourcing; scripts/review_rb_judge.sh still fetches label_helpers.sh from mutable stable/main refs.

- requirement: "Add repository-wide regression coverage to prevent mutable action or helper references from returning."
  expected_change_site: Test files covering modified workflows, helper contracts, immutable references, broker functionality, authentication, process-group APIs, and targeted_file_context.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Existing tests cover issue_pr_status.yml immutable staging and selected action pins, but no repository-wide coverage verifies immutable helper sourcing, broker replacement coverage, review_blocked_* replacements, authentication preservation, process-group metadata, or targeted-context safety; tests/test_targeted_file_context.py fails at import.

- requirement: "Preserve existing triggers, interfaces, memory behavior, and Telegram no-op behavior when unconfigured."
  expected_change_site: All modified workflows and scripts, particularly scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, and scripts/memory_helpers.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The diff deletes broker and review-blocked helpers, removes --provider-base-url and --process-group-file, replaces http.extraHeader authentication with URL-embedded tokens and unauthenticated git, changes diagnose to danger-full-access, and changes the Telegram no-op path.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
